confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Bucharest price levels, projected to July 2026. No menus, booking pages or live listings were checked. Restaurant, beer (0.5 L draft) and coffee anchors are the more reliable. Accommodation is less certain because July rates vary widely by district and demand, and recent VAT increases and ongoing inflation may have shifted levels. Cocktail and wine_glass have weaker direct knowledge, so they are set from the local price relationship to beer: cocktail at about 2.8 times the beer anchor and wine_glass at about 1.6 times.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was fixed. Levels were positioned against other Central and Southeast European capitals such as Sofia and Budapest, based on general knowledge, with Bucharest's own price points taking precedence. Accommodation reflects July peak-season demand.
